background_activity.description: A concurrent Fritz Xcode build held the shared build-cache lock during the first 27B download. The scheduler was paused while downloading continued.
background_activity.guard: For the three 27B cohorts, scripts/build-cache.py holds the shared build-cache lock throughout inference. The guard releases it while the next download runs.
background_activity.limitation: Earlier cohorts ran on a working Mac without controlling external background activity. Their timing variation may include that activity.

qwopus_weight_recovery.original_error: HTTP 404 RevisionNotFound at the catalog revision

limitations: Standalone engine probes. Measurements cover model initialization, token generation and Bosun logit readout. Application UI, tool parsing, model quality and cancellation are outside this experiment.

One machine and a single short prompt for chat. Filesystem and shader caches stayed in place. A concurrent Fritz build was observed after the early cohorts. Small-model repeats and all 27B cohorts held the shared build-cache lock. The 8B-14B cohorts remain exploratory working-Mac timings with uncontrolled background activity. Long-context throughput and hardware memory ceilings were not evaluated.
Bosun probabilities are compared with the pinned mistral.rs baseline on the five compiler fixtures. Official CPU parity and workflow qualification are separate evaluations.

method.engines: Pinned Release arm64 probes on Metal. llama.cpp uses the same dylibs as the size experiment. mistral.rs uses the Fritz pin with its Metal feature, and a local GGUF loader using the existing context, single sequence and disabled prefix-cache settings.
method.build: Copy the mistral-probe Cargo.lock from the size experiment, add either and serde_json as direct dependencies, run cargo build --release --offline inside scripts/build-cache.py with scripts/compiler-cache.sh, and stage/strip/sign its executable. Build llama-probe.cpp with xcrun clang++ -std=c++20 -O3 -arch arm64 -mmacosx-version-min=15.0 using the pinned include and ggml/include directories, -lllama -lggml -lggml-base and -Wl,-rpath,@executable_path. Stage beside the signed size experiment dylibs.
method.assets: Downloaded through Fritz's installer into an isolated model directory. Recomputed SHA-256 before each cohort. No timing runs overlapped model downloads or other inference probes. The Qwopus catalog revision returned HTTP 404, so the same SHA-256/size artifact was recovered from the explicitly recorded alternate revision. Files above 15 GB were removed from the experiment directory after their cohorts, and four measured medium-size artifacts were also removed to make room.
method.repetitions: Three sequential fresh processes per engine and model, alternating engine order. Files were read for checksums before inference, and filesystem and Metal caches were left intact.
method.startup: Monotonic wall time from entry to the model and context being ready. Rust timing begins after Tokio runtime initialization. The engines may perform different initialization work, so a separate one-token request measures latency after ready.
method.chat: Identical fixed ChatML text, compared on independently tokenized prompt IDs. 8192-token context, single sequence, greedy decoding, separate first one-token request followed by a 128-token request with fresh sequence state. The common wall-clock generation measure is completion tokens divided by request time, including prompt prefill. A supplemental decode rate divides 127 steps by decode time when both produced 128 tokens. Mistral reports decode duration in accumulated truncated milliseconds, whereas the C++ probe uses high-resolution elapsed time including sampling.
method.bosun: Fritz's pinned F16 GGUF and tokenizer reference. Checked 256 decision marker IDs and the five frozen prompt token arrays. Three rounds per process. Used Mistral's production raw-logits path with no KV cache and llama.cpp's final-position logits with context memory cleared between rows. Timed readout includes copying eligible scores to the host. Neither sampled tokens.
method.bosun_inputs: Use rows[i].prompt from tests/fixtures/bosun-compiler-reference.json for bosun/i.txt and candidate count then space-separated token_ids for bosun/i.tokens.

import hashlib
import json
import os
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
repo = root.parent.parent
catalog = json.loads((repo / "Sources/Fritz/LocalModels.json").read_text())["models"]
bosun = next(m for m in json.loads((repo / "Sources/Fritz/DecisionModels.json").read_text())["models"] if m.get("engine") == "bosun")
engines = {"llama": root / "llama/benchmark", "mistral": root / "mistral-probe-bin"}
installer = repo / "dist/Fritz.app/Contents/Resources/fritz"
env = {k: os.environ[k] for k in ("PATH", "TMPDIR", "LANG", "LC_ALL", "DEVELOPER_DIR", "HOME") if k in os.environ}
env.update(FRITZ_MODELS_DIR=str(root / "models"), FRITZ_DATA_DIR=str(root / "data"), HF_HUB_OFFLINE="1")
attempts = root / "attempts"
attempts.mkdir(exist_ok=True)


def execute(command, output, errors, timeout):
    with output.open("w") as stdout, errors.open("w") as stderr:
        start = time.monotonic()
        child = subprocess.Popen([str(x) for x in command], stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr,
                                 stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, env=env, start_new_session=True)
        try:
            code = child.wait(timeout=timeout)
            return {"status": "ok" if code == 0 else "failed", "exit": code,
                    "wall_seconds": time.monotonic() - start}
        except (subprocess.TimeoutExpired, KeyboardInterrupt) as e:
            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
            try:
                child.wait(timeout=5)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                child.wait()
            if isinstance(e, KeyboardInterrupt):
                raise
            return {"status": "timeout", "exit": child.returncode, "wall_seconds": time.monotonic() - start}


def verify(manifest, decision):
    assets = manifest["files"] if decision else [manifest]
    actual = []
    for asset in assets:
        path = root / "models" / asset["file"]
        with path.open("rb") as src:
            digest = hashlib.file_digest(src, "sha256").hexdigest()
        if path.stat().st_size != asset["size"] or digest != asset["sha256"]:
            raise ValueError(f"size or SHA-256 mismatch for {path.name}")
        actual.append({"file": path.name, "size": asset["size"], "sha256": digest})
    return actual


def measure(manifest):
    ident = manifest["id"]
    decision = manifest is bosun
    result_path = attempts / f"{ident}.json"
    if result_path.exists():
        raise ValueError(f"existing measurement: {result_path}")
    path = root / "models" / manifest.get("entry_file", manifest.get("file"))
    status = {"model": ident, "architecture": manifest.get("architecture", "bosun"),
              "memory_gb": manifest["memory_gb"], "revision": manifest["revision"], "runs": []}
    if not path.exists():
        print(f"Downloading {ident} ({manifest['size']/1e9:.2f} GB)", flush=True)
        status["download"] = execute([installer, "decision-models" if decision else "local-models", "install", ident],
                                     root / "downloads" / (ident + ".log"), root / "downloads" / (ident + ".err"), 1800)
    try:
        status["assets"] = verify(manifest, decision)
    except (ValueError, OSError) as e:
        status["asset_error"] = str(e)
        result_path.write_text(json.dumps(status, indent=2) + "\n")
        print(f"{ident}: {e}", flush=True)
        return
    print(f"Measuring {ident}", flush=True)
    failed = set()
    for trial in range(3):
        order = ["llama", "mistral"] if (trial + selected.index(manifest)) % 2 == 0 else ["mistral", "llama"]
        for name in order:
            if name in failed:
                continue
            base = attempts / f"{ident}-{trial}-{name}"
            output = base.with_suffix(base.suffix + ".jsonl")
            errors = base.with_suffix(base.suffix + ".log")
            result = execute([engines[name], path, "bosun" if decision else "chat",
                              root / ("bosun" if decision else "chat.txt")], output, errors, 240)
            result.update(engine=name, trial=trial)
            result["events"] = [json.loads(line) for line in output.read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith("{")]
            status["runs"].append(result)
            result_path.write_text(json.dumps(status, indent=2) + "\n")
            print(f"{ident} {name} trial {trial+1}: {result['status']}, {result['wall_seconds']:.1f}s", flush=True)
            if result["status"] != "ok":
                print(errors.read_text(errors="replace")[-450:], flush=True)
                failed.add(name)
    if manifest["size"] > 15_000_000_000:
        # This directory holds only downloads owned by the experiment.
        path.unlink()


wanted = set(sys.argv[1:])
selected = [bosun] + sorted((m for m in catalog if m["memory_gb"] <= 32), key=lambda m: m["size"])
if wanted:
    selected = [m for m in selected if m["id"] in wanted]
for model in selected:
    measure(model)

import json
import os
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
pid = 39419
manifest = json.loads((root.parent.parent / "Sources/Fritz/LocalModels.json").read_text())["models"]
models = sorted((m for m in manifest if m["memory_gb"] <= 32 and m["size"] > 15_000_000_000), key=lambda m:m["size"])


def command(target):
    result = subprocess.run(["ps", "-p", str(target), "-o", "command="], capture_output=True, text=True)
    return result.stdout.strip()


def signal_runner(sig):
    value = command(pid)
    if not value:
        return False
    if "dist/runtime-benchmark/run.py" not in value:
        raise RuntimeError("scheduler PID no longer belongs to this experiment")
    os.kill(pid, sig)
    return True


if len(sys.argv) == 2:
    index = int(sys.argv[1])
    current = models[index]
    print("Timing under Fritz build-cache lock:", current["id"], flush=True)
    signal_runner(signal.SIGCONT)
    start = time.monotonic()
    complete = False
    while time.monotonic() - start < 1500:
        receipt = root / "attempts" / (current["id"] + ".json")
        if index + 1 < len(models):
            following = models[index+1]["id"]
            children = subprocess.run(["pgrep", "-P", str(pid)], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.split()
            found = [child for child in children if "local-models install " + following in command(child)]
            if found:
                signal_runner(signal.SIGSTOP)
                complete = True
                break
        elif not command(pid):
            complete = True
            break
        time.sleep(0.2)
    if not complete:
        signal_runner(signal.SIGCONT)
        raise RuntimeError("guard timeout")
    data = json.loads(receipt.read_text())
    assert data["model"] == current["id"]
    print("Completed guarded model:", current["id"], flush=True)
else:
    repo = root.parent.parent
    log_path = root / "background-build-observation.json"
    observation = {
        "detected": True,
        "description": "A concurrent Fritz Xcode build held the shared build-cache lock during the first 27B download. The scheduler was paused while downloading continued.",
        "guarded_models": [m["id"] for m in models],
        "guard": "For the three 27B cohorts, scripts/build-cache.py holds the shared build-cache lock throughout inference. The guard releases it while the next download runs.",
        "limitation": "Earlier cohorts ran on a working Mac without controlling external background activity. Their timing variation may include that activity.",
    }
    log_path.write_text(json.dumps(observation, indent=2)+"\n")
    try:
        for index, m in enumerate(models):
            path = root / "models" / m["file"]
            while not path.exists() or path.stat().st_size != m["size"]:
                time.sleep(2)
            subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(repo/"scripts/build-cache.py"),
                            sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).resolve()), str(index)], check=True)
    finally:
        signal_runner(signal.SIGCONT)

revision="002f131b886df35843254e96425eb3a7e5a8cdd8"
url=f'https://huggingface.co/{m["repository"]}/resolve/{revision}/{m["file"]}'

         "url":url,"expected_sha256":m["sha256"],"expected_bytes":m["size"],

record=root/"qwopus-download-recovery.json"
record.write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+"\n")
target=root/"models"/m["file"]
temporary=target.with_suffix(target.suffix+".benchmark-recovery")
assert not target.exists() and not temporary.exists()
digest=hashlib.sha256()
n=0
checkpoint=0
started=time.monotonic()
with urllib.request.urlopen(url,timeout=60) as response, temporary.open("xb") as output:
    while data:=response.read(8*1024*1024):
        output.write(data)
        digest.update(data)
        n+=len(data)
        if n-checkpoint >= 1024**3:
            print(f"{n/1e9:.2f}/{m['size']/1e9:.2f} GB",flush=True)
            checkpoint=n

    raise ValueError("recovered artifact does not match the Fritz catalog pin")
temporary.replace(target)
receipt.update(status="verified",actual_bytes=n,actual_sha256=digest.hexdigest(),seconds=time.monotonic()-started)

print("Verified catalog-identical Qwopus artifact",flush=True)

import hashlib
import json
import math
import platform
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
repo = root.parent.parent
median = statistics.median


def sha(path):
    with path.open("rb") as src:
        return hashlib.file_digest(src, "sha256").hexdigest()


def select(events, kind, **fields):
    return next((e for e in events if e["event"] == kind and all(e.get(k) == v for k, v in fields.items())), None)


def softmax(values):
    exponentials = [math.exp(v - max(values)) for v in values]
    total = sum(exponentials)
    return [v / total for v in exponentials]


def summarize(result, directory=None):
    runs = result["runs"]
    for r in runs:
        if r["status"] != "ok":
            log = (directory or root / "attempts") / f'{result["model"]}-{r["trial"]}-{r["engine"]}.log'
            r["stderr_tail"] = log.read_text(errors="replace")[-1200:].strip()
    is_decision = result["architecture"] == "bosun"
    result["metrics"] = {}
    for engine in ("llama", "mistral"):
        successes = [r["events"] for r in runs if r["engine"] == engine and r["status"] == "ok"]
        if not successes:
            continue
        stats = {"successful_runs": len(successes), "ready_seconds": median(select(x, "ready")["seconds"] for x in successes)}
        if is_decision:
            stats.update(
                first_readout_seconds=median(select(x, "decision", round=0, row=0)["seconds"] for x in successes),
                warm_readout_seconds=median(v["seconds"] for x in successes for v in x if v["event"]=="decision" and v["round"]>0),
                five_readouts_seconds=median(sum(v["seconds"] for v in x if v["event"]=="decision" and v["round"]==0) for x in successes),
            )
        else:
            first = [select(x, "chat", limit=1) for x in successes]
            full = [select(x, "chat", limit=128) for x in successes]
            stats.update(first_token_request_seconds=median(v["seconds"] for v in first),
                         prompt_tokens=[v["prompt_tokens"] for v in full],
                         completion_tokens=[v["tokens"] for v in full],
                         end_to_end_tokens_per_second=median(v["tokens"] / v["seconds"] for v in full))
            decode = [(v["tokens"] - 1) / v["decode_seconds"] for v in full if v["tokens"] > 1 and v["decode_seconds"] > 0]
            if decode:
                stats["decode_tokens_per_second"] = median(decode)
        if not is_decision:
            stats["first_token_from_start_seconds"] = median(
                select(x, "ready")["seconds"] + select(x, "chat", limit=1)["seconds"]
                for x in successes)
        result["metrics"][engine] = stats
    if is_decision:
        pairs = []
        for trial in range(3):
            a = [e for r in runs if r["engine"] == "llama" and r["trial"] == trial for e in r["events"] if e["event"] == "decision"]
            b = [e for r in runs if r["engine"] == "mistral" and r["trial"] == trial for e in r["events"] if e["event"] == "decision"]
            for x, y in zip(a, b):
                assert (x["row"], x["round"], x["tokens"]) == (y["row"], y["round"], y["tokens"])
                p, q = softmax(x["logits"]), softmax(y["logits"])
                assert len(p) == len(q)
                pairs.append((max(abs(c-d) for c,d in zip(p,q)), p.index(max(p)) == q.index(max(q))))
        if pairs:
            result["score_comparison"] = {"pairs": len(pairs), "top_slot_matches": sum(b for a,b in pairs),
                                          "max_absolute_probability_difference": max(a for a,b in pairs)}
    else:
        tokens = [select(r["events"], "tokens")["ids"] for r in runs if r["status"] == "ok"]
        result["prompt_token_ids_match"] = len(result["metrics"]) == 2 and all(t == tokens[0] for t in tokens)
        result["matched_128_token_workload"] = result["prompt_token_ids_match"] and all(
            all(c == 128 for c in stat["completion_tokens"]) for stat in result["metrics"].values()
        )
    return result
